boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct North Central College study environments documented by the College, from quiet library areas to computer-equipped rooms and outdoor workspace.

cards.entity_name: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons Quiet Zones
cards.title: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons Quiet Zones
cards.subtitle: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons, 320 E. School St.
cards.notes: Bring reading or independent work and use the library’s designated quiet zones when you need a lower-distraction setting.
cards.short_summary: A library option specifically identified for quiet work.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College lists quiet zones among the study areas in Oesterle Library & Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: The College identifies these as library study areas; confirm building access and availability locally.

cards.entity_name: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons, 320 E. School St.
cards.notes: Coordinate with your project group, then use one of the library’s listed group study rooms for shared work.
cards.short_summary: A library room option for working with classmates.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College lists group study rooms among the study areas in Oesterle Library & Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: The College identifies group study rooms but does not state reservation rules on this page; verify availability locally.

cards.entity_name: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons Collaborative Workspaces
cards.title: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons Collaborative Workspaces
cards.subtitle: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons, 320 E. School St.
cards.notes: Set up shared notes and laptops in the library’s collaborative workspaces when conversation is part of the assignment.
cards.short_summary: A library environment designated for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College lists collaborative workspaces among the study areas in Oesterle Library & Learning Commons.
cards.access_notes: The College identifies these as library study areas; confirm building access and availability locally.

cards.title: Oesterle Library Lab 100
cards.subtitle: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons, 320 E. School St.
cards.notes: Use this listed computer lab when your coursework needs campus software or a desktop workstation instead of your own device.
cards.short_summary: A computer-lab study setting inside Oesterle Library.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College lists Oesterle Library Lab 100 among campus computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Listed by the College as a computer lab; check lab availability and building access before relying on it.

cards.title: Oesterle Library Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Oesterle Library & Learning Commons, 320 E. School St.
cards.notes: Choose the Main Reading Room when you want a library workspace with access to one of its listed Mac computers.
cards.short_summary: A reading-room workspace with 14 listed Macs.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College lists the Oesterle Library Main Reading Room as a computer location with 14 Macs.
cards.access_notes: The College lists 14 Macs in this room; confirm computer and building availability locally.

cards.title: Boilerhouse Café Upper Level
cards.subtitle: Rolland Center–Boilerhouse Café, 29 N. Loomis St.
cards.notes: Head upstairs when you need a campus computer-lab setting; bring work that benefits from standard or specialized software.
cards.short_summary: An upper-level computer-lab location at Boilerhouse Café.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College lists the Boilerhouse Café Upper Level among campus computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Listed by the College as a computer lab; check café/building access and lab availability before visiting.

cards.title: Carnegie 200
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Hall, 10 N. Brainard St.
cards.notes: Use Carnegie 200 for desktop-based coursework, and plan to print only if your assignment actually requires a hard copy.
cards.short_summary: A Carnegie Hall computer lab with 25 PCs and black-and-white printers.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College identifies Carnegie 200 as a computer lab with 25 PCs and black-and-white printers.
cards.access_notes: The College lists equipment for this lab; check whether it is available for open use at your intended time.

cards.title: Carnegie 210
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Hall, 10 N. Brainard St.
cards.notes: Use Carnegie 210 when a PC lab supports your assignment, then save work to your approved storage before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Carnegie Hall computer lab with 25 PCs and black-and-white printers.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College identifies Carnegie 210 as a computer lab with 25 PCs and black-and-white printers.
cards.access_notes: The College lists equipment for this lab; check whether it is available for open use at your intended time.

cards.title: Multicultural Student Center
cards.subtitle: Harold and Eva White Activities Center, Room 206
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or readings and use the center’s open workspace; keep the shared setting welcoming for other visitors.
cards.short_summary: An inclusive campus workspace with a TV and multicultural book shelf.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College describes the Multicultural Student Center in WAC Room 206 as an inclusive, collaborative space with open workspace.
cards.access_notes: Located in Harold and Eva White Activities Center, Room 206; confirm access and any programming before visiting.

cards.title: Jefferson Commons
cards.subtitle: Outside Wentz Science Center, North Central College
cards.notes: Take work outdoors at Jefferson Commons when conditions suit you, using its lawn and fire-pit area as an open-air change of scene.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor commons beside Wentz Science Center.
cards.evidence_claim: North Central College describes Jefferson Commons as an outdoor activity space outside Wentz Science Center with lawn spaces and a reservable fire-pit.
cards.access_notes: Located outside Wentz Science Center; outdoor suitability depends on weather, and the fire-pit is reservable through the College event system.
